meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **thick, fragrance-free cream** choose karein—gel ya lightweight lotion ke bajay. Ingredients mein **ceramides, glycerin, hyaluronic acid, shea butter** dekhein; bahut zyada dryness ho to raat mein petroleum jelly ki thin layer laga sakte hain.[2][4]

**Achhe options:**
- **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** – dry/sensitive skin aur barrier repair ke liye.
- **Cetaphil Moisturising Cream** – simple, fragrance-free option.
- **Bioderma Atoderm Creme/Baume** – very dry ya itchy skin ke liye.
- **Vaseline Advanced Repair Lotion** – body ke liye; face par acne-prone skin ho to avoid karein.

Face wash ke turant baad halki damp skin par, din mein 2 baar lagayein—isse moisture better lock hoti hai.[4] Agar pimples easily hote hain, **non-comedogenic** cream lein; fragrance, alcohol-heavy products aur harsh scrubs avoid karein. Persistent redness, cracks, itching ya eczema ho to dermatologist se consult karein.
